purpose: Pre-registered constraints for the task08 end-to-end recommendation stage. Must not be changed after the workflow runs.
quality_bound: Wilson 95% lower bound of the held-out coding pass rate (recommender rule)
available_memory_bytes: measured live by GET /api/hardware immediately before the recommendation request
basis: min_quality 0.70 and objective 'fastest' are the dashboard's existing defaults (frontend minQuality=70); 1 GiB is the v0.1 study's memory cap. None were chosen from v0.2 results.
note: A truthful no_eligible_configuration result is a valid recommendation outcome; the constraints are not relaxed to obtain an eligible configuration.
